TEST_as_group_by:
SELECT fldNom, fldPrénom, COUNT(*) AS [Nombre de factures]
FROM tblClients AS C, tblFactures AS F
WHERE C.idCLient = F.fiClient
GROUP BY fldNom, fldPrénom;
TEST_as_group_by_having:
SELECT fldNom, fldPrénom, COUNT(*) AS [Nombre de factures]
FROM tblClients AS C, tblFactures AS F
WHERE C.idCLient = F.fiClient
GROUP BY fldNom, fldPrénom
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
TEST_like_and:
SELECT *
FROM tblClients
WHERE fldNom LIKE '?e*' 
AND fldLocalité = 'Luxembourg';
TEST_like_and_with_spaces:
SELECT *
FROM tblClients
WHERE fldNom LIKE '?e*' 
  AND fldLocalité = 'Luxembourg';
TEST_top:
SELECT TOP 2 idClient, fldNom, fldPrénom
FROM tblClients;
